description: Polling this register every morning to see whether a registrar is still accredited? Watch the record instead. Give a record id (from resolve_registrar or list_enforcement_actions) or an IANA id, and this hands back one URL that answers "has it changed" in a single conditional request: 304 if nothing we hold about that registrar has moved, 200 with the change and the publisher's own sentence if it has. Same feed as Atom for a feed reader. This register records a before and after for each change, so the feed can say what it used to say. We do not push and store nothing about you — the URL is derived from the record id, so this makes your poll cheap and definite rather than notifying you.

iana_id.description: The IANA registrar ID, if that is all you have. Where two records carry it (an accreditation row and an ICANN compliance notice) this refuses and names both record ids, because a subscription to the wrong one of the two is silent rather than wrong.

record_id.description: The record id to watch, from resolve_registrar or list_enforcement_actions. Preferred: it names exactly one record.

name: watch

current.description: What the register holds for this record right now, with its citation.

change_history.description: True where this dataset records a before and after for each change. False means the feed can still tell you THAT the record moved, by its ETag, but not what it used to say.

feed_url.description: GET this for the record's current state and change list.

feed_url_atom.description: The same thing as Atom, for a feed reader.

title: Watch one registrar for changes
